properties.name: lazy-response.executor.pool-size
properties.description: Thread pool size. Also determines the total semaphore permit count, which caps the maximum number of concurrent downstream tasks across all in-flight requests.

properties.name: lazy-response.failure-strategy
properties.description: Global failure strategy. {@code silent} absorbs failures and returns 200 with defaults/nulls. {@code fail-fast} aborts on any failure and returns 502 or 503.

properties.name: lazy-response.timeout.global
properties.description: Global timeout floor in milliseconds. Applied when no chain or per-node timeout is set.
